اقتصدوا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَصَدُوا (iqtaṣadū) /iq.ta.sˤa.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
# اُقْتُصِدُوا (uqtuṣidū) /uq.tu.sˤi.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
# اِقْتَصِدُوا (iqtaṣidū) /iq.ta.sˤi.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
